title: Value of a combining gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the Boolean inputs indexed below $n$, let $k$ be a natural number with $k\le n$, and let $x$ be such an input. For every natural number $p<2^{n-k}$, the value at vertex $n+o_C(n,k)+p$ of the gate list constructed from $f$ and $k$ equals the conjunction of the following two Boolean conditions: the heap-path integer of $x$ at depth $n-k$ equals $2^{n-k}+p$, and the binary digit at position $H_x(n-k,k)-2^k$ of the code of $f$ for $k,p$ is true. Here $H_x(o,l)$ is defined by $H_x(o,0)=1$ and $H_x(o,l+1)=2H_x(o,l)+x(o+l)$, with $x$ taken to be false outside its input indices.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on inputs indexed below $n$
$x$ is a Boolean input on indices below $n$
